summary.text: Jeff Zell is a Republican member of the South Carolina Senate for District 36, which covers Calhoun, Clarendon, Orangeburg and Sumter Counties.
He is a retired U.S. Air Force master sergeant and serves on the Judiciary and Medical Affairs committees.

paragraphs.text: Zell was born on March 18, 1980, in Bellefontaine, Ohio.
His official page lists an A.A. from the Community College of the Air Force in 2013 and a B.A., magna cum laude, from American Military University in 2024.
He served in the U.S. Air Force from 2002 to 2022 and was a Sumter school board trustee from 2022 to 2024.
His page lists the 2026 American Legion Department of South Carolina Legislator of the Year award.
His committee assignments are Agriculture and Natural Resources, Family and Veterans' Services, Fish, Game and Forestry, Judiciary, and Medical Affairs.
